summary: E2E validation of the new CRUD panel for 'Gestionar Seriales' (AdminSerialManagementModal). Logged in as admin rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve, opened /inventory → 'Gestionar Seriales (Admin)' modal → 'Por Modelo' tab → selected Morefun MF360 (hwr_6df9205c09ec). Validated: (1) global 'Agregar Serial' button visible top-right; (2) new 'Almacén' column header + per-row warehouse cells; (3) cohabitation of 4 action buttons (Devolver al Stock / Desasignar / Eliminar / Modificar) in the same cell for sold row 97240115680043; (4) Agregar flow creates QA-CRUD-9001 in 'en_stock' assigned to Pymes warehouse; (5) Modificar flow renames QA-CRUD-9001 → QA-CRUD-9001X AND relocates the warehouse to Corporativo, with the grid reflecting the new name and warehouse, no other rows broken. ONE blocker observed: the warehouse name renders '—' for the 6 pre-existing seeded MF360 serials because their persisted warehouse_id ('whs_f00b02f4') no longer exists in the warehouses collection (orphan reference / stale seed). The frontend code path is correct (UI for QA-CRUD-9001/9001X shows the right warehouse name); this is a backend data-integrity issue, not a feature bug.

minor.issue: warehouse_name resolves to null for serials whose warehouse_id no longer exists in db.warehouses (orphan ref). Affects all 6 seeded MF360 serials currently pointing to 'whs_f00b02f4'. The code at routes/inventory.py L1694-L1744 is correct; the underlying inventory_movements/serial_assignments docs reference a deleted warehouse. rca of the issue: Almacén column shows '—' for the 6 legacy MF360 serials. RCA: GET /api/admin/inventory/serials/by-item builds wh_name_map from db.warehouses (keyed by warehouse_id). The seeded movements for item hwr_6df9205c09ec reference warehouse_id='whs_f00b02f4', which does NOT exist in db.warehouses anymore (only 'whs_bdd845f6' and 'whs_40dfa046' do). Therefore wh_name_map.get(wh_id) returns None, the API serializes warehouse_name=null, and the frontend's `{r.warehouse_name || '—'}` renders the em-dash. New rows created via the Agregar/Modificar UI correctly bind to live warehouses and render their names, proving the code path is correct. Mitigation options: (a) DB backfill of orphan warehouse_id; (b) defensive fallback string in backend; (c) seed-clean script that re-points stale references.
